# The Drowned City Overview Guide: Quests, Location, Strategy & Rewards - WoW Forever

By Jurdi Updated: 2026/11/14

The Drowned City, found on the far western island west of Stranglethorn Vale, is one of the new dungeons players will encounter in World of Warcraft Forever.

~~ ~~

If you are new to WoW, please look out for this symbol throughout the guide for additional, beginner-friendly tips.

## The Drowned City Overview in WoW Forever

The Drowned City is the fabled lost Troll city of I'lalai. Inhabited by the remaining trolls and infested with the Saltseer Pirates, and culprit of the Kurzen Compounds magical corruption, adventurers have now found this fabled city and look to stop the dangers that lurk within

The recommended level for The Drowned City is between 35 and 42, and we also recommend players bring a Warlock or Shaman for underwater breathing, as there is a portion of this dungeon that requires extensive time underwater

## Location of The Drowned City in WoW Forever

The Drowned City dungeon entrance is located off the coast of Stranglethorn vale, south of the Haunted Isle, nestled deep in a cave in the ocean.
Starts with The Second Rebellion/ Bad Medicine. Completing Troll Witchery is the final prerequisite before unlocking the dungeon quest in Southshore

# The Hall of Thanes Dungeon Overview Guide: Quests, Location, Strategy & Rewards - WoW Forever

By Jurdi Updated: 2026/11/16

Related tools

Dungeon JournalWorld Map

[Button: Show Table of Contents]

The Hall of Thanes, situated under the High Seat of Ironforge, deep within Alliance territory, is one of the first dungeons most players will encounter in World of Warcraft Forever.

~~ ~~

If you are new to WoW, please look out for this symbol throughout the guide for additional, beginner-friendly tips.

## The Hall of Thanes Overview in WoW Forever

Hidden beneath the High Seat of Ironforge, the Hall of Thanes is part of the legendary "Old Ironforge", forever incapable of access in Classic Azeroth until WoW: Forever. The Hall of Thanes is the resting place of the Legendary Dwarves of the Eastern Kingdoms, but has recently been invaded by the hostile Dark Iron Dwarves

The recommended level for The Hall of Thanes is between 13 and 18, and it has started developing the nickname of "HoT".

## Location of The Hall of Thanes in WoW Forever

The Hall of Thanes is easy to get into. Players can find the open door to Old Ironforge immediately to the left after entering the High Seat of Ironforge. Players will follow the path all the way to the bottom of Old Ironforge to find the portal

Tip: Click map to zoom

Hide pins

Ironforge

Click the image to expand

Currently, Horde will have a long travel time to get here, as so far, there is no quick travel for the opposing faction of this dungeon to get here, and none have been discovered yet in-game. Horde will have to travel from Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad, venture through Arathi Highlands, Wetlands, and Loch Modan before arriving in Dun Morogh to make their way into the Dwarven capital of Ironforge. Horde players should probably remove their gear before getting close, as they'll more than likely meet their demise at the hands of the Ironforge guards several times before being able to zone in (for new players, removing gear prevents it from taking durability loss when you die).

# Explore the Drowned City: New Dungeon in WoW: Forever

Forever Posted 5 days ago by Jurdi

The Drowned City is a new dungeon that challenges players in the Level 37-42 bracket in WoW: Forever - take a look at the quests and rewards you'll find inside!

Drowned City Dungeon Guide

Our dungeon guide has everything you'll need to tackle this dungeon: where to find it, boss strategies, notable trash, and more. Stay tuned for our Dungeon Journal tool to update as well!

## New Dungeon: The Drowned City

Drowned City is a level 37-42 Dungeon located in Stranglethorn Vale, off the far coast west of the peninsula. This is a major step up in difficulty compared to the previous dungeons in WoW: Forever, and players will need to pay attention to mechanics more than usual.

  * 5 Quests for both Horde and Alliance granting 8000-10,000 Experience each
  * 6 Bosses, including 2 Rare Bosses with very powerful loot like on-use damage trinkets
 |  | 

  * Will not complete quests in one run
  * Some unforgiving trash mob packs throughout

## City of Dalaran

Image
Levels: 28–33
Location: Alterac Mountains
Access note: Alliance players can begin the required attunement questline with “An Alarming Request” from Emissary Jacques in Southshore. Horde players begin with “Key to the City” and “Prison Break-In” from Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
The magical barrier concealing Dalaran’s restoration efforts has fallen, revealing a city alive with arcane chaos. Enchantments are backfiring, constructs are running wild, and dangerous magical energies spill through the streets. After earning the Kirin Tor’s trust, your group will enter through the sewers and make its way into the city proper, choosing among multiple paths and encounters on the way to the source of the disruption.

## The Drowned City

Image
Levels: 35–40
Location: Off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, west of Grom’gol
Ancient troll ruins once lost beneath the waves have risen from the ocean, opening their newly exposed streets to exploration.
